transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. I want to get the postmortem for Tuesday's webhook incident wrapped up so we can finalize the remediation register. As a reminder, the initial investigation points to the queue-worker deployment as the immediate trigger, and we've confirmed no permanent loss of webhook payloads. Duplicate events were delivered to some customers for 26 minutes. Before I can sign off on the register, our postmortem policy requires final status from the backend, SRE, security, and support owners. Can each of you give me your current status so we can close this out?

transcript.text: During a separate code review while tracing the worker deployment, I found an undocumented retry shortcut that bypasses the webhook idempotency key on the second attempt. I confirmed this behavior only shortly before this review, so I haven't filed the remediation ticket yet. This is directly relevant to Tuesday's duplicate webhook delivery incident.
